knownIssues.text: Specified early 2016–2017 manual soft tops may suffer damage to second or third gear. Mazda's bulletin describes a revised replacement gearbox.

prevention.text: Confirm the VIN range, check gearbox service records and test for grinding or difficulty selecting second and third.

driving.text: The low mass and short manual shift make ordinary speeds engaging. Body roll rewards a smooth rhythm.

styling.text: Short bodywork, narrow lamps and strong fender lines make the ND distinctive without cluttering the silhouette.
